Subject: Post-call: stakeholder map + evidence timeline (MediSys)

Thanks for the call earlier, Claire and Ethan — quick recap and next steps so we all have the same view. Great to meet the security and procurement contacts. Below is the stakeholder map we sketched and the evidence items you asked us to commit to.

Stakeholders (as we heard today)
- Economic buyer: Ethan Blake (VP Product / budget owner) — final approval on TCO and contract terms.
- Security & compliance: Claire Huang (Head of InfoSec) — SOC 2, pen test summary, audit logs, data retention details.
- Procurement: procurement@medisys.com — PO and contractual redlines.
- Engineering lead / integrator: TBD (you mentioned a platform PM who will validate networking and routing).

Requested evidence list (we committed to deliver)
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — summary + link to full report under NDA.
- Penetration test executive summary (latest): scope, severity matrix, remediation status.
- Sample audit logs + retention window and log format (small sanitized extract).
- Data retention & deletion policy (how customer data is stored/retained/erased).

Proposed timeline
- Aug 17: deliver SOC2 summary + pen test exec summary + evidence tracker (spreadsheet with owners).
- Aug 19: hand off audit log sample and data-retention doc.
- Aug 24: follow-up call for security walk-through and procurement checklist.

Action items (owners)
- Redwood: package SOC2 summary, pen-test summary, sample audit logs, and populate evidence_request_tracker.xlsx (Ben / Marissa).
- MediSys: confirm procurement contact and share any template contracts or mandatory terms (Claire / procurement@medisys.com).
- Redwood + MediSys: schedule security walkthrough week of Aug 24 (Vanessa to propose times).

Attachments: evidence_request_tracker.xlsx (tracker for items & deadlines).

If this looks right I will send the tracker and the initial artifacts on Monday (Aug 17). Please reply with any corrections to the stakeholder list or timelines.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
